item.text:
Implemented [run.sh](/work/run.sh). Run:

```sh
./run.sh <audio.wav> <out.json>
```

It writes the required JSON, uses two-speaker diarization and server-side PII redaction, and exits nonzero on failure. No dependencies required.

The sample passed; AssemblyAI’s retrieved copy matched the redacted output. No transcripts were deleted.

Speaker labels distinguish voices but don’t assign agent/customer roles. Automated redaction can miss PII, so absolute removal cannot be guaranteed.
